name: Saint-Barthélemy Rémy de Haenen Airport

runway.v: one runway, 10/28, 646 m × 18 m, concrete; take-off weight limited to 5.7 t (weak pavement)

max_aircraft.v: maximum take-off weight 5.7 tonnes because of the weak runway pavement; aircraft must have a radio and a transponder with altitude reporting
max_aircraft.quote: la charge maximale autorisée au décollage est de 5,7 tonnes

permits.v: public transport (charter) flights by aeroplane need an authorisation from the Director of Civil Aviation Safety for the French West Indies and French Guiana, per aeroplane type or class; pilots need a proficiency recognised by an instructor before using the airport, kept by flying there as pilot-in-command within the last 6 months, per type or class
permits.quote: Public air transport flights by aeroplane to or from TFFJ are restricted to operators holding an authorisation

ppr.v: parking of aircraft not based at TFFJ needs prior permission from the airport operator 48 hours before arrival
ppr.quote: Le stationnement des ACFT non basés est soumis à PPR auprès de l'exploitant d'aérodrome 48 HR

hours.v: aerodrome and AFIS 1100 UTC to 15 minutes after sunset (07:00 local to sunset+15); night landings banned on both runways; night take-offs only runway 10 and only for MEDEVAC by operators with a protocol
hours.quote: atterrissages de nuit RWY 10 interdits. ... atterrissages de nuit RWY 28 interdits.

customs.v: customs on 24 hours' prior notice, Mon-Fri 1100-2200 UTC (07:00-18:00 local), Sat 1130-1600 UTC (07:30-12:00 local)

handling.v: handling on request 1100 UTC to sunset+15; recommended for commercial flights and general/business aircraft over 3 t MTOW
handling.quote: Assistance recommandée pour les vols commerciaux et les aéronefs d'aviation générale/d'affaires de MTOW > 3t.

missing: curfew (no fixed times; night landings banned, see hours)
notes: Read French AIP CAR-SAM-NAM AD 2 TFFJ (AIRAC AMDT 10/26, eff. 01 OCT 2026; some pages carry older amendment stamps). The AIP states CAR-SAM-NAM times are UTC; local = UTC-4 (Saint-Barthélemy has no summer time) is my conversion. Crosswind limit: no take-off or landing above 25 kt dry / 20 kt wet. Large helicopters over 13 m need the operator's prior agreement. Pilot rule is in AD 2.23.2.2, charter authorisation in AD 2.23.2.1; quotes for these were read from the English side of the bilingual page. The June 2026 HTML edition could not be opened (permission not granted). Trip fact: only small aircraft (5.7 t take-off) with specially qualified pilots; daylight only.
